story_plan.moment: After the cinema's final screening, Gu stops a film leader on a handwritten correction from the projectionist who trained him.
story_plan.meaning: The correction fixes a cue mark he had misunderstood for years. The old booth will close in the morning, but this practical piece of advice can still travel.

complete_world.full_wardrobe: A faded indigo canvas work jacket with buttoned cuffs and a cotton flannel shirt, dark work trousers, resoled brown boots and an old key ring on his belt.
complete_world.full_action: Gu threaded the spare leader onto the hand rewinder, braced the reel on the bench and slowed the rotation until the translucent pencil arrow met the inspection plate.
complete_world.offscreen_context: The shuttered auditorium and a stack of dismantled seats are below the booth. A red fire bucket and the outgoing film can wait beside the stairs.

choice.world: A neighborhood cinema keeping its original projection booth until the final night

costume_plan.context_and_climate: A warm projection room with heat left over from the lamp and a draft along the floor.
costume_plan.role_foundation: An indigo work jacket protects against the dusty booth hardware and keeps loose cloth clear of the rewinder shaft.
costume_plan.style_adaptation: Keep his established workwear cut. The buttoned cuffs hold the indigo sleeve close above his fingers.
costume_plan.visible_style_detail: Buttoned cuffs pull the indigo sleeve into a neat taper just above his fingers.

camera_style.medium: Close documentary still from the adjoining workbench
camera_style.lighting: The amber inspection plate lights the film from below; a dim tungsten bulb from camera left edges the fingers and jacket cuff
camera_style.palette: Amber film, blue-black indigo and brown shadows
camera_style.texture: Matte canvas, translucent film edges and faint scratches on the glass
camera_style.framing: The fingertips meeting the film edge stay clear of the soft reel hub.

camera_plan.viewpoint: Over the edge of the bench, level with his fingers and the film gate
camera_plan.optics: 80mm macro at f/5.6, focused across the clear leader and both fingertips
camera_plan.reason: The old projectionist communicates through a single pencil arrow. Staying at bench height gives it visual weight and lets the hesitation register in the fingertips.

photographer_selection.intentionally_unshown: Only the cuff, hands and leader belong in this photograph. His face, the auditorium, the key ring and the boots stay in the complete world beyond the bench.

scene_design.subject: An adult projectionist's hands arrest a strip of film above the inspection plate.
scene_design.setting: The booth after the final screening; the glass inspection plate is the last bright surface on the bench.
scene_design.action: Gu stops the strip by the perforated edge when a crooked pencil arrow comes into the square of light.
scene_design.cue1: The pencil arrow crosses out a grease mark beside the second perforation.
scene_design.cue2: An unplugged rewinder cable curls across the back of the bench as the spool stops.
scene_design.wardrobe: An indigo canvas sleeve with a crease polished by years against the workbench.
scene_design.composition: Keep the lit arrow and two fingertips at the center of the frame.
scene_design.action_physics: His left index finger rests against the reel flange while his right thumb and forefinger steady the perforated film edge.

emotion_review.final_tone: The ache of closing night interrupted by the pleasure of finally understanding.
emotion_review.visible_expression: His face stays outside the frame; the index finger pauses against the flange.
emotion_review.review_note: The fingertips and the arrow carry the recognition in the same instant. The surrounding objects only establish the booth after the screening.

creative_notes.story: 最后一场电影散场后，顾川把备用引片倒回灯板。师傅画在孔边的歪箭头解释了多年前他记错的提示点，拆掉的放映室还留了一样东西给他。
creative_notes.emotion_action: 他的脸在画外。两只手刚好停在不同的支点，食指压在盘边，另一只手护住片孔，犹豫停在那一拍。
creative_notes.outfit: 沿用顾川已经有的实用穿衣习惯。深蓝帆布扣袖能避开转轴，保留手肘多年在工作台上摩擦出的亮痕。
creative_notes.camera: 镜头贴着台边和引片齐平。透光板在下面把石墨笔迹照出来，左边钨丝灯只给指关节和袖口描边。脸、钥匙和楼下座椅都在画外。
creative_notes.visible_clues: 斜箭头盖在旧油笔点上，是师傅留下的改动。断开的电源线说明这一拍的回卷由人手完成，机器已经收工。
creative_notes.review_focus: 核对片孔、两只手的接触方式和引片受力，确保箭头容易读懂，光从板下透出，暗处仍能分辨旧帆布。

creative_audit.focus_evidence: Reviewed continuity of the imported role, the physical rewinder action, the pencil correction and the face-free bench crop.
